integrity.proof_basis: Exact Gaussian coefficient extraction, cubic discriminant, and the strict L^m triangle inequality.

limitations: Only the exact degree-two harmonic space on S^2 and integer even exponents are treated.
The lower endpoint classification is proved only for real-valued harmonics; the complex result is a sharp upper bound.
No claim for non-even exponents, higher degrees, or independent scientific priority confirmation.
title: All even-moment rigidity for quadratic spherical harmonics on the two-sphere
